build_command:
@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0.."
call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul

literal_guard_microbenchmark.caveat: Instrumented operator new, MSVC /O2, finite logits plus preserved failure behavior. Isolates literal diagnostic overhead, not model speed. Before and after use the same source; production runtime.hpp changes between builds.
literal_guard_microbenchmark.build_command:
@echo off
setlocal
cd /d "%~dp0.."
call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
cl /nologo /O2 /EHsc /std:c++17 /I backends\glm5next /I build-local\glm5next-candidate-cuda\_deps\glm5next_candidate-src\include /I build-local\glm5next-candidate-cuda\_deps\glm5next_candidate-src\ggml\include /I build-local\glm5next-candidate-cuda\_deps\glm5next_candidate-src\src build-local\check-glm-logit-guard.cpp /Fo:build-local\check-glm-logit-guard.obj /Fe:build-local\check-glm-logit-guard.exe
exit /b %errorlevel%

limitations: No new full HTTP, long-context, Linux/HIP or full Qwen/DeepSeek tests.
Full saved F32 check applies to shared scratch before the literal guard overload; final guard build is covered by CTest and full-model pipe/references.
Shared scratch is opt-in; measured memory saving is not proof of throughput gain.
